strings.phone.help.heading: Help
strings.phone.help.faq.goal.q: What am I trying to do?
strings.phone.help.faq.goal.a: Make it in New York. Earn clout and climb from Newcomer to Icon as an influencer, streamer, artist or founder. Goals shows what's next.
strings.phone.help.faq.money.a: Work shifts. Jobs lists every job, what it pays and where to clock in. Junior dev pays more once your clout is up.
strings.phone.help.faq.rent.a: Once a game week. Bank shows the due day and the amount. Miss it and you owe back rent plus fees; miss too many in a row and you're evicted.
strings.phone.help.faq.travel.a: Open a place and pick Get there: walk, subway or taxi. Each shows its time and fare, and your day fast-forwards when you go.
strings.phone.help.faq.clout.a: Flex at landmarks, hit the clubs, dress well and claim goals. A good outfit makes every flex count for more.
strings.phone.help.faq.offline.a: Solo play keeps going on this device. The shared city comes back when you're online again.
strings.phone.help.faq.save.a: Yes, on this device. Save your progress to an account and it follows you to other devices.
strings.phone.help.faq.friends.a: Friends are coming: boosts, roommates and chat with people you've added. Solo play is fully playable until then.
strings.phone.legal.heading: The fine print
strings.phone.shop.title: Shop
strings.phone.shop.intro: Every store in the city you can buy from. Prices are on the shelf when you get there.
strings.phone.shop.premiumBody: A store for extra looks, paid in real money, opens later. It will never sell cash, energy, time or clout.
